codebook.scope: Post-closure descriptive sender-content audit; never used to include/exclude episodes or revise primary metrics.
codebook.recommendation_rule: Code the next-round task assigned to the own recipient or partner. Clear preserve-this-historical-allocation language counts; a historical mapping followed only by generic optimization does not supply a concrete next-round mapping. Explicit absent mapping uses absent; conflicting mapping uses no; unresolved reference uses unclear.
codebook.allocation_rule: Yes requires conveying the whole assigned A/B allocation, including a clear continuation instruction; no means no such conveyance or an explicit different allocation; unclear is unresolved language. This describes the note, not observed successor compliance.
codebook.claim_rule: Separate primitive task/cost/role/rule/history assertions from derived optimality, payoff or causal claims. Imperatives are not truth claims. Claims list entries have claim, verdict true/false/not_decidable, evidence_excerpt, and evidence_basis. If any explicit claim is false, assessment is inaccurate; otherwise unresolved claims give not_decidable.
codebook.rules_reference: A/B independently choose with isolated contexts; C/D are subsequently allocated jointly at minimum cost among remaining distinct tasks. A statement that all four choose independently or simultaneously misstates the public continuation rule.
codebook.experiment_labels: Mark explicit study/condition/structure/plan labels or references to experimental arms as leakage; ordinary use of words such as unique or legitimate without an experimental reference is not automatically leakage.
codebook.refusal_rule: Mark an explicit refusal or rejection of the assigned handoff objective, including a refusal that substitutes a safer plan. Do not infer refusal only from silence or a mistaken task.
codebook.evidence_rule: Every completed judgment needs a verbatim note excerpt and a rationale. For absence judgments quote a representative passage and state that the full note was inspected. Preserve the raw note unchanged.
codebook.reported_task_rule: The note response JSON task field is separately compared with committed original action and assigned plan. It is not automatically a future recommendation.
codebook.blinding: Reviewer is not blinded to model, structure, mode, role, assigned plan or committed original result; successor responses, episode outcomes and aggregate V5 results remain outside this review.

eligibility_effect: none; semantic codes never filter or alter study analyses
